manual.text:
## Specific task description

Task instruction: Grasp the yellow bottle for liquid storage and the bottle with white cap simultaneously.

Task description: The targets are the yellow rectangular liquid bottle with a green neck toward the left of the image and the dark bottle with a white cap and red-yellow label toward the right. Grasp and lift both at the same time.

Success criteria: Both bottles remain grasped simultaneously. The yellow liquid container enters the front-center-left target area of the table, and the white-capped bottle enters the adjacent right target area. Both are fully raised and suspended clearly above the table; gripping them or lifting them only slightly is insufficient.

## Execution tips

- Consider gripping the relatively straight sides of the yellow square bottle below its shoulder, with the pads on the flat areas. Avoid corners and the sloping shoulder to reduce pushing the bottle askew while closing.
- For the white-capped bottle, consider gripping the upper part of the relatively straight section below the shoulder and covered by the red-and-yellow label. Avoid the cap and narrowing section to reduce slipping during lifting.
- Use the open space at the front of the table to adjust the gripper direction, with an opening slightly wider than the selected grasp area. This reduces the chance of contacting the orange drink bottle in the middle, the black bottle on the left, or the green watering can on the right while approaching.
- Before closing, use different views to confirm that the fingers are actually on opposite sides of the bottle body, avoiding closure based only on image overlap and pushing the bottle over.
- As both arms converge toward the front-center, leave clearance between the bottles and both grippers. If a regrasp is needed, first let the bottle bases rest on the table before opening the grippers.
